title: Plant-Based Asian Mushroom Sauce
description: Homemade approximation of the HelloFresh sachet. No published ingredient list could be found, so this is a sensible copycat. One batch replaces one sachet.

steps.text: Stir together. A vegetarian stand-in for oyster sauce; the soaking liquid from dried shiitake adds depth. Use the whole batch wherever the recipe calls for 1 sachet.
